reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a report description that writes more than one REPORT HEADING, PAGE HEADING, CONTROL HEADING FINAL, CONTROL FOOTING FINAL, PAGE FOOTING or REPORT FOOTING group, whichever spelling (full or abbreviation) each occurrence uses, in paged and unpaged reports alike; one of each is legal.
reader.edition-search: Read ScreenReportGroupCensus, GroupKindOf, BindGroupType and the CH/CF level loop of ResolveReports: the only Edition members used are Edition.At and Edition.Error (EditionContext#Error records the diagnostic with no edition test). Grepped VersionConformancePass for ReportGroupType/OrPage/census: only VisitReportGroupType (operand forms, SR4's path), nothing on group counts.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: 1985 SR2 lists CH FINAL and CF FINAL with the singleton groups; 2023 moves them to SR14 (one per control level), which the one census enforces identically by counting FINAL as a control level.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover RH, CH FINAL and CF FINAL twice and a legal census; PH, PF and RF twice, mixed full/abbreviated spellings and an unpaged report were not exercised (probed here).
